names.zh: 毒液穿甲炮

descriptions.en: Ice wave generator: slams enemy ships with waves of frozen particulate freezing enemy propulsion systems and slowing them to a standstill.
descriptions.zh: 冰浪发生器：通过发射冰冷微粒所形成的波浪来打击敌舰，这种攻击能冻结敌舰的推进系统，使其动弹不得。
